record.title: Erez and Kerem Shalom hostilities restrictions, November 2019
record.scope: Passenger and goods crossings on the Gaza–Israel de facto boundary
record.crossings: Erez / Beit Hanoun and Kerem Shalom / Karm Abu Salem
record.direction: Crossing movements both ways, with separate goods categories
record.movement: Previously eligible passengers and ordinary goods traffic
record.exceptions: Erez exceptional cases on November 13–14; indirect report of power-plant fuel permitted November 14.
record.enforcement: COGAT closure statement corroborated by OCHA and PCHR operational records.
record.relationship: Promotes and partly resolves prior lead R2-ME-L04; separate from May 2019 and later Gaza episodes.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current closure status inferred.
record.official_rationale: Security during escalation between Israel and Palestinian armed groups.
record.context: A short additional restriction within the longstanding Gaza crossing regime.
record.uncertainty: November 17 restored pre-escalation eligibility, not unrestricted travel. OCHA cargo closure language and indirect fuel exception have different category coverage; no all-category continuous interval is inferred.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. A single uninterrupted closure duration is not supported for the combined categories and phases.
